title: The Nine Secrets Appear
summary: As Li Ruoyu meditates and Clumsy Peak's inheritance stirs, the Bodhi Stone pulls Ye Fan into a Dao Rune world where he must defeat a perfect copy of himself, and by 'surpassing himself' he comprehends the Jie Secret, one of the Nine Secrets, which can multiply power up to tenfold but is hard to trigger. Li Ruoyu reveals he knows Ye Fan has the Ancient Desolate Sacred Body and promises to keep it secret. Ye Fan agrees to belong to Clumsy Peak but says he must first find a missing friend and the Domain Gate; Li Ruoyu lets him leave whenever he likes but forbids him to teach the secret to anyone, including Ziyue. Elder Xu brings hopefuls from the main peaks now that the inheritance has revived, and Li Ruoyu gives them half a month to comprehend something at the peak. Ziyue, calling herself Clumsy Peak's senior disciple, tries to wheedle the secret out of him, offers to help him win back 'that beauty', and threatens to expose the Demon Emperor's Sacred Heart, the Mother Qi of All Things and the Green Copper. Li Xiaoman then arrives to warn him to leave Taixuan because Star Peak is looking into him, but he refuses to go yet.

title: Holy Body Fist Shatters Natal Star
summary: Ziyue and Li Xiaoman trade barbs over Ye Fan until Star Peak disciples arrive to demand an explanation for the disciples he hurt. Li Xiaoman urges him to apologise, but Ye Fan says they trespassed on a main peak's inheritance ground, refuses, and beats the whole group. Star Peak's Senior Brother Chen Feng, an Other Shore cultivator, then demands that Ye Fan kneel and attacks with a star-power Jade Disc, the Twelve Galaxy Swords and three cloud, moon and star treasures, which Ye Fan blocks with the Green Copper while Chen Feng realises he is at the Divine Bridge realm. Ye Fan also produces fragments of the Great Void Hand Seal, leaving an onlooker wondering how he learned the Void technique from the short excerpt they wrote him. Chen Feng binds him with his natal star, the Big Dipper, and Heavenly Pivot divine swords; when the Jie Secret fails to trigger, Ye Fan smashes the natal star with his fist, and Chen Feng answers with the Seven Star Transformation to lock space and time.

title: Escape from Taixuan
summary: Ye Fan finally triggers the Jie Secret, overwhelms Chen Feng with several times his normal power, and spares his life. Two Star Peak elders arrive, but Li Ruoyu smooths it over as a finished contest between peaks and they leave. Li Ruoyu then calls out a hidden watcher: Ji Hong, a Ji family Immortal Platform elder whom Ziyue calls Ancestral Grandfather, who exchanges Void and Clumsy Peak techniques with Li Ruoyu and says he has come to take her home. Ziyue flees with Ye Fan and quizzes him about the Void technique and the Nine Secrets; he lures Ji Hong away and promises to come back to her. Days later, still searching for the Domain Gate, Ye Fan meets the Old Madman grieving that Tianxuan is dead, learns the Tianxuan Holy Maiden was his junior sister, and studies the madman's footprints, which form a complete Dao-pattern footwork technique. He decides to follow the madman in case it leads to another chance.

title: Meeting the Old Madman Again
summary: Ye Fan follows the Old Madman through a barrier hidden inside the mountain to Taixuan's Domain Gate into the Forbidden Land, where three guardian elders attack the madman as he breaks the formation, crying that he must go back and save 'them'. In the Void Corridor, Ye Fan tells him he was brought to Beidou from his home and begs to learn the technique to return, but the madman only repeats that everyone is dead and Tianxuan has fallen, then wraps himself in a cocoon of divine silk as the gate collapses in void destruction while protecting Ye Fan. Ziyue finds Ye Fan apparently lifeless; when he wakes she bites him and makes him promise never to vanish without a word again. Li Ruoyu warns that destroying the Domain Gate is a crime even he cannot shoulder. Taixuan elders identify Tianxuan formation patterns on the cocoon, meaning it holds a Tianxuan expert from 6,000 years ago, before Ji Hong claims it for the Ji family. As word spreads to the great families and holy lands, Li Ruoyu tells Ye Fan to stay hidden, and a zither's sound draws him away.

title: Clash of the Prodigies
summary: Hua Yunfei invites Ye Fan to sit and listen to his zither while every power in the Eastern Wasteland gathers at the ruined Taixuan Domain Gate. At the cocoon, Jiang Ming of the Jiang family and a Yaoguang elder confront Ji Hong, each claiming the right to protect the Saint inside, until Jiang Ming proposes that the young generation decide it: whoever touches the cocoon first takes it home. The Holy Son of Yaoguang, Yao Xi, Jiang Yifei and Ji Haiyue, all captioned at the Four Poles realm, step forward, and Ji Haiyue brags about his brother before being ordered back as Ji Haoyue arrives from fighting the demon race at Xuanyuan Valley. The Holy Son's Golden Light Fortress, Ji Haoyue's Great Void Hand Seal and Jiang Yifei's Eight Gods Brutal Force clash, and Jiang Yifei cracks the fortress with a blow aimed at the heart. Meanwhile Ye Fan and Hua Yunfei talk about Ye Fan's home, which Hua has heard about from Li Xiaoman. The cocoon then goes out of control and the elders scramble to form a restraining formation.

title: Star Peak Gathering
summary: As the elders struggle to contain the rampaging cocoon, Ye Fan rushes in to shield Ziyue, guesses that the cocoon is unstable because its Tianxuan formation runes have faded, and carves them back to calm it. An elder who watched him accuses him of knowing Tianxuan rune formations and presses him about the Old Madman; Ye Fan says he met the senior only once, and Ziyue backs him up. Hua Yunfei, acting for the Sect Master, invites the elders and Ye Fan to drink at Star Peak, where the elders recall Tianxuan Holy Land's overnight annihilation in the Ancient Forbidden Land, the Demon Emperor's death almost 10,000 years ago, and the coming contest to become emperor. Ji Hong praises the Jiang family's Hengyu Great Emperor inheritance, while Jiang Yifei compares Ji Haoyue to the Ji family's Void Great Emperor. Later Ziyue finds Ye Fan asleep and tries to draw a pig's nose on him, they bicker and she bites him, and Ye Fan's quip that they 'ate, lived and travelled together' enrages Ji Haoyue. Haoyue attacks, senses that Ye Fan's body resonates with his Divine Body, and pins him with his Moon Rising over the Sea phenomenon.

title: Holy Body vs Divine Body
summary: Ziyue protests that her brother is at the third secret realm while Ye Fan is only in the Wheel Sea realm, so Haoyue suppresses his realm to the Divine Bridge and unleashes all nine wheels of the Nine-Wheel Luminous Moon; Ye Fan withstands it, which the elders say only a Divine Body should manage. Ziyue threatens to disown her brother if he strikes again, and Hua Yunfei asks him to stop out of respect for Taixuan, so Haoyue leaves. Ji Hong sees through Ziyue's 'ordinary friend' story and wants to recruit Ye Fan into the Ji family, the Yaoguang elder offers endless source and medicine, and Jiang Ming invites him to the Northern Region, while Yao Xi privately warns him to choose quickly. To escape, Ye Fan claims he once entered the legendary Bronze Immortal Palace and took a wisp of the Mother Qi of All Things, credits it for his strength, and hands the elders a map to it. Ziyue scolds him for sending people to their deaths, but he gives her essence of the Mother Qi of All Things as a farewell gift, repeats his promise and leaves, while Yaoguang and the Jiang family set out for the Bronze Immortal Palace in the Southern Region.

title: Escort Across a Thousand Li
summary: In a tavern, cultivators say the Peacock King, a demon great power who dominated the Southern Region 800 years ago, has challenged the Ji family alone on behalf of Yan Ruyu, the Demon Emperor's descendant, slaughtering Ji members, forcing Ji experts back from the Bronze Immortal Palace and hunting Ji Haoyue, and that the Ji siblings have fled to Qixia Mountain. There Ye Fan finds Ziyue, nearly out of divine power, hunted by black-robed men, one of them a straw-cloaked Dao Palace cultivator who covets her Primordial Spirit Physique and notices Ye Fan's Ancient Holy Body. Ye Fan lures the pursuers into a Crested Thunderbird nest and they escape with the Void technique. Ziyue says Ji Hong was killed by the Peacock King on the way home, Haoyue's fate is unknown, and Ji Hong's last order was to seek Nangong Zheng at Qixia Mountain; they agree to keep each other's physique secrets, suspecting the black-robed men aren't demons but body-devourers. A disguised stranger turns out to be the Peacock King, who says he came for Ye Fan, remarks that the Demon Emperor's Sacred Heart chose him well, offers news of his old friend, and then brings out his 'gift': Nangong Zheng.

title: Great Powers Shake the Land
summary: Nangong Zheng, who reappeared because of the Bronze Immortal Palace, says the Ji family head promised him a disciple to carry on his legacy if he saved one of the siblings, and invites the Peacock King to enter the palace with him to seek immortality together rather than die alone. The Peacock King refuses, and their duel pits his 'Stars Shining in a Clear Sky' phenomenon against Nangong Zheng's 'Wooden Pillar Splitting the Sky', tearing up the land around Ye Fan and Ziyue. Drained and unable to use the Void technique herself, Ziyue teaches Ye Fan the complete Void technique so he can carry her out, even though the Ji family's curse on the secret art wounds her for passing it on. Elsewhere a black-robed agent reports to his Master that Ye Fan has the Ancient Holy Body. Ye Fan revives Ziyue with divine spring water, and she asks to be taken to her Great-Aunt Ji Hui. Pursued again, they are ambushed at Imperial Water Gorge just as Ji Ren of the Ji family, a Dao Palace cultivator, arrives.

title: Repaying Kindness with Enmity
summary: Ji Ren apologises to Ziyue for arriving late, and then Great-Aunt Ji Hui, a Four Poles elder, drives off the pursuers and says Ji Haoyue is safe and being treated at the Ji Residence. Ji Hui coldly warns Ye Fan away from Ziyue and gives him a small reward to 'draw a clear line'. Hua Yunfei arrives, and Ji Hui explains that her mother was a Hua from Taixuan, so Yunfei is family, and that she arranged his duel with Haoyue two years ago. Before Ye Fan leaves, Ziyue warns him never to use the Void technique in front of Ji members and gives him her jade pendant. On the road, Ji Ren, who learned only half the Void technique in 60 years of service, ambushes him to 'take it back', transforms into his true form and uses a True Spirit Artifact. Ye Fan tricks him into absorbing Xuanhuang Qi heavy enough to flatten a mountain, and as Ji Ren begs for his life Ji Hui appears, admits she sent him, and warns that killing Ji Ren makes Ye Fan an enemy of the Ji family; Ye Fan answers that one day he will walk into the Ji family's holy land and tells the 'smelly old woman' to live long enough to see it.

title: Killing Pursuers in Desperation
summary: Ji Hui brands Ye Fan a thief who stole the Ji secret art and killed her loyal servant Ji Ren, orders Ji disciples to hunt him to the death, and keeps Ziyue locked in a formation even after Ziyue confesses that she taught him the Void technique. Hiding in a snake cave, Ye Fan refines the pure source Ji Hui gave him as a reward and reaches the peak of the Divine Bridge. Three Ji elders chase him through ten formations across a thousand li, and he fights them off with Ji Ren's Heavenly Glory Net, which he has refined, and the Ji family's illusory-body method. Cornered in a city tower, he threatens to shout the Void technique to the whole city, and the Ji leader answers that he will kill one person for every word, which Ye Fan condemns. The Peacock King appears, says he and Nangong Zheng called a truce, and declares that the Ji family's enemy is his friend, even as a Ji messenger warns that the Ji family head has left seclusion. At Xuanyuan Valley he tells Ye Fan that Pang Bo is now 'only an empty physical body', but Ye Fan still insists on finding his friend.

title: Demon Clan Breakout
summary: Ye Fan seeks out a fairy who has been watching him, almost certainly Qin Yao, and when she teases him about Pang Bo's whereabouts he tries to force the answer out of her. At that moment the Ji family and the Yaoguang Holy Lord, an Immortal Platform master, lay siege to the Peacock King at Xuanyuan Valley to avenge the Ji massacre. Qin Yao sends Ye Fan out through the back of the valley, tells him Pang Bo and Princess Yan Ruyu have gone to the Northern Region, and warns him not to head north into the Fire Domain; he resolves to find a Domain Gate to the north. Ji Hui catches him, lists his 'three crimes' and drives him to the edge of the Fire Domain. Yao Xi appears and offers a way through if he agrees to go back to Yaoguang with her, and he accepts. On her instructions he ignites the Fire Domain with the Heavenly Glory Net and dives to its fifth layer, where a Yaoguang ancestor carved a teleportation altar, but Ji Hui follows and knocks him into the sixth layer, which is full of Violet Fire and Sourceless Fire.

title: Reaching the Other Shore
summary: Sure that the Sourceless Fire has turned Ye Fan to ash, Ji Hui still vows to guard the Fire Domain's entrance for seven days. On the sixth layer, his Xuanhuang Qi can't hold back the Violet Fire, but the Bodhi seed in his bottle resists it, so he uses the Violet Fire and the Mother Qi of All Things to reforge his cauldron fragments, with the Green Copper damping the flames. Working over an unknown stretch of time, he completes the Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron, with two ears for Yin and Yang and three legs for heaven and earth, which can block the Violet Fire. Meanwhile Ziyue, told Ye Fan is dead and blamed for the elders the Ji family has lost, breaks away to the Fire Domain because her jade pendant is still glowing, and ignores Hua Yunfei's pleas to stop. The black-robed man who hunted her at Qixia Mountain appears, promising his Master he will deal with things this time. Ye Fan faces the dangerous step from the Divine Bridge to the Other Shore; memories of his friends drive him on, a green lotus blooms from his Wheel of Life, and he crosses the Bitter Sea to the Other Shore.

title: Farewell to Ziyue
summary: Ye Fan's Mother Qi manifests as armour and he turns on the black-robed man who hunted Ziyue, who is ready to die to claim the Ancient Holy Body for his Master; a flashback shows the man being recruited by that Master, who wants special physiques like Ziyue's and Ye Fan's. Ye Fan survives by a thread and then, speaking of Hua Yunfei's zither, makes clear he sees Hua Yunfei's hand in the attacks; Hua Yunfei lets him go with a 'we'll meet again'. Ziyue says Ji Hui will stop hunting him for her sake and begs to travel north with him, and he agrees, but he then leaves her behind, reasoning that he isn't of this world and the Ji family is the safest place for her. Hua Yunfei tells Ji Hui everything he did was for her and argues that Ye Fan's cauldron and Holy Body could one day shake the world, but she rebukes him for deciding on her behalf. title: Battle with the Holy Maiden
summary: Ye Fan comes out of a broken Domain Gate still somewhere in the Southern Region, where Ji Haiyue, Ziyue's fifth brother, ambushes him with his 'Jade Ice and Snow' to punish him for stealing the Ji family's secret art. title: First Look at the North
summary: In Yaoguang's mine, the overseers lay down their three rules (mine, mine, and keep mining while you breathe), kill a miner for hiding a Source Stone, and say labourers can buy their freedom in ten years. Lao Dawei, a chatty miner of two and a half years, befriends Ye Fan and tells him about the Northern Territory: the holy lands' competing mines, the 13 bandit groups, a primordial ancient mine nobody returns from, sources that seal fearsome creatures, and a green iron 'pyramid' that shook the mine until a mysterious old woman intervened. Ye Fan secretly refines Source Stones until he breaks the Moon Palace seal and feels his Bitter Sea again, and Lao Dawei catches him in the act. Overseers then pick both of them for a new gallery where an unusual source lies, and blood-red water seeps from the walls. Mutated miners and evil creatures pour out, most of the group is killed, and Lao Dawei dies searching for his lost eyes. Ye Fan concludes that an evil creature from antiquity was sealed in the source.

title: Source Arts Emerge
summary: Zhang Wuye shows off his ancestral stone compass and explains that his forebears held the title Heavenly Source Master and that a Great Emperor of old gathered the divine source of nine dragon veins into Purple Mountain. At the stone gate that hides the scroll, stone-clad dead cultivators attack, Ye Fan saves Lei Bo and Wang Shu, and Zhang Wuye is knocked out and carried home, where the villagers mourn him and briefly blame Ye Fan until he wakes. Lei Bo and Wang Shu tell Ye Fan that a Zhang ancestor once beat a Jade Lake (Yaochi) Holy Maiden in a wager and that the North has had only five Heavenly Source Masters, then show him a topographic map of Purple Mountain carved by that ancestor, Zhang Lin. After a day of study Ye Fan reads it as 'Nine Dragons Guarding One Pearl' and finds the true entrance hidden in the Yin shadow of the dragon veins. Zhang Wuye then admits that Heavenly Source Masters' hair turns red in old age and they come to bad ends, and that Zhang Lin entered Purple Mountain to escape that curse and vanished along with the Heavenly Book of Source. title: Treasure Hunt in Purple Mountain
summary: Wearing stone clothing, Ye Fan, Lei Bo and Wang Shu ride a runaway mine cart down ancient tunnels dug along the dragon veins into Purple Mountain, driving off swarms of demon bats with the Pure Spirit Fire Ye Fan gave them. They pass the jade-like bones of a once-peerless expert and reach the Yin-Yang Cave, where Ye Fan waits for the 'Isolated Yang' moment and cuts through its energies with the source-skin stone knife after the bickering pair fumble the knives. Past it lies a hoard of Source Stones bigger than any warehouse, along with traces of those who came before, including the Jiang family's Divine King and the Holy Maiden who lost to Zhang Lin, and inscriptions showing that Zhang Lin followed an earlier Zhang Jiye into the 'Emperor Mountain'. A purple vein drags Lei Bo and Wang Shu away. Searching for them, Ye Fan meets Jiang Taixu, the Divine King of the Eastern Wasteland, still alive, who asks his realm; Ye Fan says he reached the Other Shore after four years of cultivation, and Jiang Taixu judges him far too weak.

title: Battle Saint Method
summary: Jiang Taixu notes that Ye Fan reached the Other Shore in four years, as the ancient Zhang Jiye did with stone clothing and knives, and says a powerful mind method would speed him up. He places Ye Fan in a trial space full of monsters that strike at the innate body, and Ye Fan comprehends the Dou Secret, another of the Nine Secrets, and its Battle Saint Law, which can even trigger his Jie Secret. Drained, Jiang Taixu explains he has been locked in battle with an Ancient King clan creature under Purple Mountain for 4,000 years, refuses rescue, and guides Ye Fan past the body of Yan Yi, a Yaochi Holy Maiden of long ago, towards a Great Emperor's dojo. Ye Fan promises to come back stronger, or at least to bury him. He finds Zhang Jiye's remains, a man who got this far with a mortal body, staring at the wall on which the Heavenly Book of Source is carved. Ancient creatures awaken around him until a bell tolls, and, recalling that Great Emperor Wu Shi's weapon was a bell, he realises this is Wu Shi's dojo as his ancient jade resonates and he finds Gu Tianshu's poem 'Who is supreme at the end of the Immortal Road'.

title: The Heavenly Book of Source
summary: The bell's toll suppresses the ancient creatures, and in what seems to be Great Emperor Wu Shi's residence Ye Fan finds Jiang Taixu's handwritten lament that he could not learn the emperor's method, and a Stone Book sealed by Wu Shi that also forms a gate. His ancient jade opens a Void Corridor that takes him to an ancient mine beneath the dragon veins, where a strange creature evades him, and he then finds Lei Bo and Wang Shu, who refuse to believe he already has the Heavenly Book of Source until he shows them. Back at Stone Village, Zhang Wuye offers him the book; Ye Fan says he only needs to read it once, but agrees to keep it and swears to return it when a worthy Zhang heir appears. A black shadow creature from Purple Mountain steals roast lamb in the village and slips through the void, but it seems harmless. Studying the book, Ye Fan gains the Divine Awareness of the Heavenly Source, with a Yin black pupil and a Yang white pupil. Lei Bo then reports that Wang Shu, showing off his source knowledge, is held as collateral at a five-storey stone-gambling shop, and Ye Fan picks a stone by its Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches grid position, 'row two, column three', and prepares to cut it.

title: Showing Might at the Stone Workshop
summary: Ye Fan and Lei Bo fight their way up the floors of the Qingxia Sect's stone-gambling workshop to reach the owner holding Wang Shu. Ye Fan wins on every floor, cutting a Ghost Crack Stone for 500 grams of source and then a Red Fire mutated source. On the fifth floor Young Master Liu Cheng'en of the Qingxia Sect wins the first 50 kg bet by secretly switching stones. Ye Fan then stakes himself, picks the low-grade stones the experts threw away, and cuts an Ancient Larva Source worth 150 kg. When Liu hands over Wang Shu, the stones stored there have brought out Wang Shu's and Lei Bo's hidden traits: horns, and blood that glows silver. Liu calls them man-eating ancient creatures and urges Ye Fan to kill them for revenge. Ye Fan refuses: old grudges shouldn't pass down the generations, and he only fights invaders and bullies. The Qingxia Sect declares him an enemy, and he beats Liu's men.

title: Qingxia Sect Runs Rampant
summary: Zhang Wuye explains that Stone Village's ancestor, a Source Master, once brought home two children with silver blood and glowing foreheads. The ancestor sealed their bloodline and married them to humans, and Wang Shu and Lei Bo are their descendants. Ye Fan trains the pair by having them haul stone pillars up a mountain. They awaken their forehead power and soon match cultivators at the Divine Bridge realm; the episode's lore card names their bloodline the Silver Blood Clan, one of the ten Ancient King clans. Ye Fan's earlier attempt at Dao Palace failed, but with the source he has saved he tries again, driven by the thought of his aging parents and going home. After half a day five divine energies surge into the sky and an 800-year-dead tree comes back to life. His Wheel Sea reaches perfection and he leaves the Bitter Sea behind for a higher realm. The Qingxia Sect then raids Stone Village to avenge Young Master Liu, and Wang Shu and Lei Bo crush the raiders. Ye Fan takes the two of them straight to the Qingxia Sect's mountain, beats its disciples, and announces he will found his own sect on its grounds.

The Lihuo Sect Master sees through it and seals the hall, and Tu Fei bursts out of hiding; he calls Ye Fan 'Brother Genius' and warns him not to compete for the Yaochi Holy Maiden.

title: Daoist Gu Feng Appears
summary: At the Mining Sect's celebration Ye Fan admits to Zhang Wuye that his resource needs are enormous and time is short. Wang Shu and Lei Bo recall how their blood stirred at the workshop near seven stones held for Yaochi, all from the Taichu (Primordial) Ancient Mine. Ancestor Zhang Lin's notes say tens of thousands of kg of source can be gathered fairly safely at the mine's outer edge. Meanwhile the Yaochi Holy Maiden asks the Yaoguang Holy Master to help her enter the mine and re-seal the stones. She notes that the Jiang family's Emperor Heng Yu once used the mine as a weapon forge, and the Holy Master offers his Holy Son and Holy Maiden. In Source City, 30,000 miles from the mine, Tu Fei throws himself at the Yaochi Holy Maiden's carriage and ends up in a fight with Yao Xi and the Yaoguang Holy Son. He also mentions the Ji family's bounty on a Wheel Sea cultivator named Ye Fan, rumoured to have hurt Ji Hui, burned a supreme elder to death, and become tangled up with a Ji daughter.

title: Taichu Ancient Mine
summary: Old Sabre leads a small party toward the Taichu (Primordial) Ancient Mine: Ye Fan disguised as Daoist Gu Feng, Li Desheng, and several others. He warns them that careless talk about the red-haired thing said to live there gets people killed. When someone touches source ore he ends the tour 100 miles from the edge. The party demands its money back, and then a black wind of Yin-Yang energy sweeps them into the mine's domain; Ye Fan's Li Fire Divine Furnace repairs itself from the damage. As monsters close in, the episode ends on the lore of Emperor Heng Yu's weapon-forging site.

title: The Source Master's Curse
summary: Deep in the Taichu Ancient Mine, a 'Corpse Star Sea' appears. Elsewhere in the mine, the Yaochi Holy Maiden's party pushes on to suppress the source. Ye Fan finds Heavenly Source patterns left by the fourth-generation Source Master, who sealed the place and completed nine pages of the Source Heaven Book. Through those patterns he relives the ancestor's final struggle: a voice hunts someone called Wu Yi with the curse that strikes Source Masters in old age, the backlash for using arts that defy heaven's creation. For a moment Ye Fan loses control of his own body. He finds a dried-out divine source, the Green Jade Turtle, and then saves the panicking party from a swarm of creatures by stabilizing the terrain with Source arts. After glimpsing three humanoid 'forbidden god' silhouettes, the group flees through land that a black hole keeps swallowing. One member uses an escape chant his grandfather taught him, and Ye Fan borrows the power of the fourth-generation master's source map. They reach Crimson Moon Cave, a place of extreme yin that links to Fallen Sun Hill, a place of extreme yang: together they form the site where Great Emperor Heng Yu forged his weapon.

title: Enter the Black Emperor
summary: Leaving the forbidden zone, the Yaoguang Holy Son and the Yaochi Holy Maiden thank 'Daoist Gu Feng' for purifying the monster, repairing the Dao runes and saving her. Ye Fan claims he's looking for his wayward 'disciple' Duan De. Word arrives that the Ji family is hosting a young heroes' conference in Quzhou, and that someone named Tu wants to meet Gu Feng in Chaoyang City. The Holy Maiden, who has recognized Ye Fan through his source arts, takes him to Yaochi's temporary residence. There he seals seven stones from the mine: three left by Zhang Lin and four found by a past Yaochi Empress. He notes that four of the seals aren't Zhang Lin's work. He asks for the Xihuang Scripture, the best Dao Palace method, to reach the Six Immortal Prohibition Seals, but Yaochi never shares it and takes no male disciples. Hei Huang boasts that he knows where the Queen Mother of the West wrote her scripture. His eye falls on an old turtle jade from Ye Fan's mine haul, and he agrees to set up a teleport formation that needs three items.

title: Remains of the Ancient Holy Body
summary: As the countdown runs, Tu Fei keeps Qing Yi drinking and Hei Huang breaks the barrier to take the Azure Dragon King's aura. Qing Yi's guards storm the treasury. Ye Fan's mind resonates with the ancient Holy Body skeleton and splits in two. Inside it he sees a dried-up golden Bitter Sea with a green lotus that still stirs, and a Dao Palace treasury peak refined with millions of kg of source. What the skeleton holds isn't a cultivation method but a secret technique for building a 'single secret realm', which the Dao Scripture can also achieve, only more slowly. They escape as time runs out, leaving the treasure seemingly untouched. Qing Yi's adviser reports that the barrier was broken by an insider and that the trail leads to the Ageless Palace, so Qing Yi orders the city searched. Hei Huang uses the stolen aura and the bought materials to make a temporary small world and break the Meteorite Forest's five-element and star-field barriers. The breakthrough takes Tu Fei's Sky-Devouring Demon Pot, star stones and the Black Turtle Shell. Inside the Ageless Palace the old demon in Pang Bo mocks Yan Ruyu's scheming and says he'll regain Immortal Platform and rule Beidou with Pang Bo. He offers to reveal a star road home if Ye Fan walks away, and Ye Fan refuses.

title: Showdown at the Ageless Palace
summary: The old demon in Pang Bo has tempered the body back to the Four Poles secret realm. He brushes off Ye Fan's divine-sense strike and fights Ye Fan, Tu Fei and Hei Huang with the strength of a true dragon. Ye Fan's Heavenly Source divine art binds him for a moment. Hei Huang then sends Ye Fan's divine consciousness into the demon's own consciousness space. There the demon lists the realms from Wheel Sea to Immortal Platform and boasts that even his reduced self is beyond them. Ye Fan forges a sword from the green lotus inside his mind, and the demon answers with the Demon Emperor's Nine Slashes. Hei Huang joins the mental fight, offers a trade for his 'Black Emperor Book', and has his golden bell smashed before he collapses. Ye Fan realizes the Nine Secrets work in the mind as well. Using the Dou secret's symbol, he names the demon's three sins (stealing a body, enslaving the Demon Clan, prying into Ye Fan's origins) and passes sentence.

title: Slaying the Old Demon King
summary: With the Nine Secrets symbol, Ye Fan multiplies his battle power and divine sense tenfold and crushes the old demon inside the consciousness space. The dying demon reveals he knows of 'ancient China' (Earth) and compares himself to King Zhou, then tries to self-destruct and take them all with him. Pang Bo absorbs the demon's remaining consciousness and takes his body back. He wakes unsure whether he's human or demon, but with the demon's memories. Hei Huang plays dead, then leaps up to fight over the Ancient Demon Emperor Book, which records the Nine Slashes. When Qing Yi's search party bursts in, Pang Bo, using the demon's memories, poses as the Demon King and scares Qing Yi off. They agree Pang Bo will stay in the Demon Clan as a stand-in Demon King to keep it united, as Yan Ruyu wants. He'll help Ye Fan from the inside, since the demon's star road home can't be trusted. Qing Yi's adviser works out the whole plot, but Qing Yi waves him away. Ye Fan goes to Qin Yao's residence to thank her.

title: Battle with Qin Yao
summary: Tu Fei drags Ye Fan out at night to 'gather information' in Demon City, and Qin Yao talks with Ye Fan about the Great Emperors (Xu Kong, Heng Yu, the Queen Mother of the West, the Azure Emperor) and the Azure Emperor's lost ambitions. Ye Fan entrusts Pang Bo to Qin Yao and Yan Ruyu. Qin Yao insists that since he won the contest he belongs to her, and when he tries to leave they trade playful blows. Hei Huang bursts in: Tu Fei, drunk, has told a fox demon the Demon King is fake and been arrested. Qing Yi, Ye Fan and two elders, including Elder Niu, question Tu Fei with the Azure Emperor's truth wine. Tu Fei deflects every question. The fox demon then reveals that the commander Jin Yan made the arrest without orders, because he wanted to marry Qing Yi and run the clan. Qing Yi, mortified, strips Jin Yan of his command and sends him to serve as Jin Chi's guard. Tu Fei had taken an antidote all along. A demon girl who adores Qin Yao chases Ye Fan for making her sister-in-arms lovesick, and Hei Huang opens a formation for Li City.

title: Pre-Qin Qi Refiners
summary: Chased out of Demon City, Hei Huang's teleport misfires and drops Ye Fan, Tu Fei and Hei Huang in the Divine Desert, where Hei Huang says he was once trapped for a hundred years. He explains that Great Emperor Heng Yu created the desert with his sun furnace's fire while fighting a non-human being of Great Emperor strength from the Taichu Ancient Mine. Afterwards Heng Yu made a pact with something in the mine, founded the ancient Jiang family, and never again came within 250,000 km of it. Ye Fan sees that the stars overhead are false: a formation uses the star map, with Polaris as its center. It leads them to a Dao Temple moved here from another world. Its walls hold pre-Qin writing, including the words of Xu Fu about the three sacred mountains and the elixir of immortality. Through the Nine Dragon Coffin's star pattern Ye Fan wakes visions of Zhuang Zhou's butterfly dream and a Go-board killing formation. He also sees two pre-Qin Qi Refiners who closed the Ancient Starry Sky Road to protect Earth and left a relic for a descendant to bring home, and flashes of the five-colored altar, Li Xiaoman, Zhang Wenchang and Liu Yiyi. Ye Fan breaks the Go game and wins the God-Beating Whip.

title: Danger in the Divine Desert
summary: The God-Beating Whip turns out to strike divine consciousness, and it stings Hei Huang when he grabs for it. In the Divine Desert, bandits at the third and fourth levels of Dao Palace are working captured laborers to death, and Hei Huang takes them down. Their leader Xu Yuan is a fifth-level Dao Palace cultivator whose power is blocked. He offers to lead them to 10,000 pounds of stored source and a divine source, and is spared once he claims kinship with Tu Fei. Tu Fei confirms that Xu Yuan is the grandson of Xu Tianxiong, the Third Great Bandit, and a notorious lecher. The Four Poles cultivator Chen De arrives to avenge his young master. Ye Fan fights him with the cauldron while Hei Huang sets up a formation. Chen De reveals that a mysterious Source Master sealed a divine source in his body to hold down his cultivation and help him break into Four Poles. Ye Fan suspects this is the same person behind the four seals that weren't Zhang Lin's. Tu Fei protests at Chen De's 500 slaves, is captured, and has his power sealed by a God-Sealing Ring. Ye Fan follows a messenger to Heishi Village in Anzhou.

title: Clever Plan to Protect Ziyue
summary: Xu Tianxiong's projection demands his grandson's safety and orders Tu Tian to come see him. Ye Fan strikes first with the God-Beating Whip, hitting the projection's divine consciousness, and keeps Xu Yuan as a hostage rather than start a war with a Great Bandit. Among more than 10,000 kg of looted source they find a fragment of a bronze bell with Dao runes. Li City records say the bell belonged to an ancient family, later a Daoyi Holy Maiden's family, that once held one of the Nine Secrets. Tomb raiders stole it and died of its curse, and its five fragments now lie with noble families and Holy Lands, who are meeting in Li City to open the ancient tomb. Tu Fei heads home. In Source City Ye Fan, calling himself 'Zheng De', meets the grave-robbing Daoist Duan De, who claims to know the route Gai Jiuyou took to Li City 8,000 years ago. Duan De proposes ambushing the Ji ship carrying Ji Ziyue's fragment to Ji Haoyue. A demon squad under Jin Yan attacks the ship, Duan De leaves Ye Fan to take the blame, and Ye Fan defends the Ji party, but Jin Yan still grabs a fragment. At the Li City site gather Ji Haoyue, the Yaoguang Holy Son and Yao Xi, Jiang Yifei, Lu Ling of Daoyi and Jin Chi with the stolen piece. Ziyue then arrives with a second Ji fragment, and Ye Fan, disguised, challenges Jin Chi's claim.

title: Ancient Tomb of Li City
summary: After the fight over the fragments, Jin Chi, the Little Peng King, makes his follower Jin Yan kneel and apologise to the Ji family, and Yao Xi asks 'Daoist Gu Feng' (Ye Fan in disguise) to help her side. A bronze bell, an ancient artifact, opens the underground ruins of Li City, a site 15,000 years old, and the young elites fall inside and are scattered. Ji Haoyue asks Gu Feng to report any news of Ye Fan to the Ji family, and Gu Feng calls Ye Fan 'sly, wicked and very cunning' to his face. Ji Ziyue goes missing and Jin Chi chases her, and Ye Fan steps in to protect her. The groups gather at a Red Gate guarded by a tomb guardian, where Duan De lectures them on how to open it; the Ji side brings the relic key and everyone strains to pull the gate open. The guardian monster copies the Ji family's Heavenly Eagle Slash, the Jiang family's barbaric strength and Yaoguang's Golden Wall, and grows stronger the more it is hit, until Ye Fan tries his Source Arts on it. The episode ends with the Daoyi Holy Land's disciple leader (Lu Ling) turning up.

title: Exploring Wu Shi's Resting Palace
summary: Ji Ziyue explains that the tomb is really three identical overlapping spaces; her special body lets her cross between them with the Great Void Technique, and the guardian can only be killed by sealing it in all three at once. Gu Feng (Ye Fan) sets up a formation and the young elites strike together to destroy it. Inside, where power is capped at Dao Palace Level 5, Ziyue recognises Gu Feng's chin-touching habit and accuses him of being the man who knocked her out and ran, but Daoyi's Holy Maiden Lu Ling defends him. When everyone pours spiritual energy in, the Yaoguang Holy Son pulls out and exposes Lu Ling's plan to seal their power and take the inheritance, so she withdraws and opens the last step for the others. Privately, Lu Ling has seen through Ye Fan's disguise. She offers him the inheritance if he can survive a combined attack from the three prodigies.

The scroll shows a Holy Cliff stained by a fallen Ancient Holy Body and a map of Purple Mountain, and on Hei Huang's advice they trick Duan De into taking the map as bait. In disguise, Ye Fan sells bounty hunters a fake lead to a cave, then robs them. title: Ancient Divine Silkworm
summary: The Ancient Divine Silkworm, a primordial creature that eats divine source and can go through nine transformations, turns into a dragon and nearly escapes before it is caught, and Gu Feng is declared champion with over a million jin of source. When Daoyi, the Ji family and Yaoguang bid for it, Gu Feng offers ten-year 'rentals' instead, and Great Xia pays 800,000 jin because the prince's younger sister wants it. An Miaoyi asks Gu Feng to deliver a box to the Ancient Holy Body that may help him reach the Four Poles. At New Stone Village, Ye Fan absorbs his winnings and breaks into Dao Palace Level 5. title: Holy Body Suppresses the Dao Fetus

Hei Huang finds the Ten Thousand Dragon Nest, where Wu Shi once forged dragons, and Ye Fan picks the dragon pearl of a True Dragon Immortal Medicine before the tree flees and ancient beasts chase them out. Zifu Holy Land cultivators ambush them and are captured to work as 'miners'. The captured disciples boast that their Holy Lord's trip to Purple Mountain is backed by a king, and Ye Fan realises the Divine King Jiang Taixu is in danger. title: Li Fire Suppresses an Old Acquaintance
summary: In the Holy City, Ye Fan finds Old Jiang and Tingting running an inn near the Jiang family, and learns that some in the Jiang clan no longer believe the Divine King Jiang Taixu is alive after 4,000 years of searching. To pass on the news secretly, he spreads it as rumour and sends the Jiang family a letter carrying the Dou secret that Jiang Taixu taught him under Purple Mountain. The Jiang Holy Lord and Jiang Yun (both Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) recognise the Dou secret, and Jiang Yun swears as the Divine King's direct descendant to unseal the clan's ancestral weapon and bring him back. Jiang Yichen (Four Poles), who once hunted Ye Fan, comes after the Mother Qi cauldron and the Dou secret. Ye Fan beats him, but spares him when he claims Tingting's Taiyin body depends on his medicine, and extracts a Heavenly Life Fruit for her; Tingting in turn tells Ye Fan the scroll she gave him is the Hengyu Scripture. Narration says the Jiang family rescues Jiang Taixu from Purple Mountain at great cost, waking something ancient there, and his old enemies gather to wipe out the Jiang family. Ye Fan arrives at the Jiang gates asking to see the Divine King.

title: The Hengyu Divine Furnace
summary: Jiang Taixu has been rescued, but his life force is nearly spent and he lies in the Jiang family's Dragon Transformation Pool while enemies from 4,000 years ago close in. Ye Fan presents himself to Jiang Yun, and when Doctor Wang Shen says the family's medicines are exhausted, Ye Fan gives up the crystal of the True Dragon Immortal Medicine, which should revive the Divine King in three hours. As attackers break the Great Emperor formation, Ye Fan rejects retreat or negotiation and proposes a Source Arts deception: fake divine-source mist, illusory formation flags and a deliberate opening, all backed by the Hengyu Divine Furnace. The trap splits the enemy's thirteen Holy Lords and lets the Jiang reactivate the Great Emperor formation. Three Old Demons (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven), corpses twisted by eating Yinming grass, then go for Jiang Taixu. Ye Fan holds them off with the God-Beating Whip, which strikes divine sense, until Fairy Caiyun of the Wanchu Holy Land (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) appears.

title: The Divine King Revives
summary: Fairy Caiyun, who waited 4,000 years for Jiang Taixu, borrows Ye Fan's whip and puts the three Old Demons back in their graves. The Dark Night King (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven), one of Zhongzhou's Twin Kings, whose brother Jiang Taixu killed long ago, then attacks to destroy the Jiang clan. Ye Fan burns the Mystic Fire of his divine furnace to resonate with the Hengyu Divine Furnace and restart part of the Great Emperor formation. With thirty minutes left, Caiyun burns her own life force to power the dragon pearl, asking that her aged face be covered with a white cloth, and dies. Jiang Taixu wakes and traps the Dark Night King in his Divine King Holy Land, and although the king wears a Sage's battle robe made to counter it, Taixu kills him. Grieving, Taixu lifts the cloth, vows to win back Caiyun's young face from heaven, and remembers his promise to watch the sunset with her.

title: The Release Assembly

The Old Golden-Winged Peng King (Immortal Platform 2nd level) and Yaoguang demand the prodigies Ye Fan sealed, and Taixu orders them all released: Jin Chi, the Yaoguang Holy Son and Holy Maiden, the Zifu disciples, Zi Xia and even a Jiang clansman. title: Holy Body Breaks into Four Poles
summary: An Miaoyi visits Ye Fan before his breakthrough, reveals that her gift box held an Ancient Enlightenment Tea leaf, and asks him to become her Dao protector. She says that if he defies fate and becomes the first Holy Body in a hundred thousand years to reach the Four Poles, she too can break her destiny. Three great elders guard the ceremony while Ye Fan attempts the breakthrough in the Dragon Pool, which also contains the lightning. The heavenly tribulation brings thunder beasts and then chaotic lightning, and Ye Fan appears to be destroyed; his friends think he is gone. At his lowest he thinks of his parents and his wish to go home, refuses to die, and is reborn in the lightning. He breaks into the Four Poles, and visions appear around him: the Chaos Green Lotus seed, the Yin-Yang Life and Death Diagram, and the Immortal King Descending on the Ninth Heaven. With the elders held back by hidden powers, a group of peak Four Poles cultivators rushes in to kill him before he stabilises.

title: Immortal King vs Jiuyou

Still disguised as a boy, Jiuyou challenges Ye Fan to make him her pill ingredient and slave. She uses the Jiuyou Immortal Song, its Sound World and the God's Eye, which onlookers link to Gai Jiuyou, a legend who was one step from Great Emperor 8,000 years ago. title: Stone Gambling Yields Divine Medicine
summary: Jiang Taixu has forbidden anyone to hunt immortal medicine for him, so Ye Fan decides to find divine medicine by gambling on stones instead. He challenges Nangong Qi of the Ancient Source Technique clan, an heir of the Earth Source Masters, at Yaoguang's Sky Stone Garden in the Holy City, each side starting with 1.5 million catties. In round one Nangong cuts 500,000 worth, while Ye Fan buys ten cheap Wind-Moving stones, one of which hides a primordial insect worth 800,000, and wins. In round two Nangong's 'Foolish Elephant' stone holds the head of an ancient royal clan member. title: Nirvana Scripture Soothes Wounds

Neither can heal the Great Dao wound. An Miaoyi explains that the Holy Body may need the power of heaven and earth from ancient times, which survives only in the seven Life Forbidden Zones, and Ye Fan chooses to risk them rather than live on without power.

title: Braving the Undying Mountain

They see an unidentified flying object from outer space and chase it toward the Undying Mountain, one of the seven Life Forbidden Zones, where an ancient formation throws them deep inside past the River of Forgetfulness and the Yellow Springs. Nannan wanders unharmed among the Headless Knights and can see the Void Great Emperor's formation lines, which lets her guide them. Divine Physician Wang Shen, who owes the Divine King Jiang Taixu, 'examines' him and publicly gives him fourteen days to live unless he gives up his cultivation, which Ye Fan announces he will do in order to draw his enemies out. summary: Ye Fan studies the Three Seals and works out that they must be used in sequence: Heaven Overturning to bind, Mountain Embracing to crush, Human King to kill. Yan Yunluan, healed by Xiao Mingyuan with Xiao family arts, comes back with Mingyuan for revenge. Ye Fan tests the combined seals on Yan. Yan breaks through mid-fight and conjures a heavenly-tribulation thunder bell, but Ye Fan hijacks the tribulation to break into Dragon Transformation himself. When Xiao Mingyuan tries to blood-sacrifice Lu City's people to summon Xiao clan elders, Ye Fan kills him, even though Mingyuan says his clan is allied with the Wang family of the Northern Plains. Yu Die promises to smooth things over, and she and Dongfang Ye offer to help find a Dragon Transformation scripture in the Immortal Palace realm. At another entrance they find Duan De running a scam. Ye Fan catches him in a formation prepared by 'a mighty being', and Dongfang Ye strips him of his loot, including King Yuhua's Nine Divine Weapons.

title: Deity Battle at Immortal Burial
summary: The Xiao clan swears revenge for Xiao Mingyuan, and Xiao Xia (Immortal Platform 1st level) sets out to ambush Ye Fan. Ye Fan, Yu Die and Dongfang Ye follow a blind old map-seller into the Immortal Burial Ground deep inside the immortal mansion world. The blind man notices Ye Fan's Heaven Source Master inheritance and uses the crowds he has sold maps to as trap-clearers. They meet a naked Duan De, and Ye Fan hands back the robe he 'found'. The lords of the Jiuli Divine Dynasty and the Great Xia Dynasty (both Immortal Platform) arrive and argue over who owns the site. A God's Thought, the undying malice of a primordial god buried there, wakes and kills everyone who uses energy. During the chaos a Xiao grandmaster attacks Ye Fan, who fights him hand to hand and outwits him. The blind man leads a chant from a scripture that pacifies the God's Thought. Beyond it lies a world-within-a-world that keeps the laws of the primordial era. Ye Fan gives Dongfang Ye a Golden Crow bone, lets Yu Die keep a golden egg, and keeps a fragment of Immortal Tears Green Gold carved in ancient god script.

title: Twin Thunders Shake Central States
summary: At the heart of the burial ground stands a coffin carved from Enlightenment Tea Tree wood, and Great Xia and Jiuli wield Emperor weapons to fight over it. Duan De shows a demon face, the mark of the Ruthless Great Emperor, and brings out half of the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Jar. The blind old man reveals himself as the Blind Heaven Old Man, Second Great Bandit of the Northern Plains (Immortal Platform). When the coffin is opened it is empty apart from the Dragon Transformation volume of the Great Emperor Scripture. Ye Fan studies it and sets off two heavenly tribulations in a row. He uses them to drive off the God's Thought and reaches the 3rd level of Dragon Transformation. His Mother Qi Cauldron shows who he really is, and he leaves with the tea-tree wood. He gives Yu Die and Dongfang Ye a token so they can find Pang Bo. The Xiao clan asks the Wang family for help, and Wang Chong (Dragon Transformation) attacks with a king-grade war chariot. Ye Fan crushes him with King Yuhua's jade weapons and takes the chariot, and at the end Wang Teng's divine sense appears.

title: The Northern Emperor Appears
summary: Wang Teng's divine sense scolds Wang Chong and then fights Ye Fan evenly. Its heavenly eye keeps up with Ye Fan's speed, and it uses one of the Nine Secrets to predict his moves before it fades. In his seclusion chamber the real Wang Teng confines Wang Chong for a year and sends Wu Guli and Jin Wuduo to bring back Ye Fan's head. Yu Die brings Pang Bo to Ye Fan. Pang Bo explains that Hei Huang's teleport dumped him in a Central States dragon vein for two and a half years, where he reached Dragon Transformation 4th level, and that he is now a Qishi Academy student. At the academy's Moon-Star Lake a star map shows Mars and Earth. Pang Bo says each era the academy sends its top three prodigies off-world, and he lists the rivals: the Yaoguang Holy Son, Hua Yunfei, Jue Youqing, Qi Lin, Xiang Yufei and Wang Teng. To grow stronger and learn about the Nine Secrets, Ye Fan heads for a Jiuli auction selling Purple Dragon Marrow and King Biluo's Biluo Bell.

title: Enlightenment of Eight Prohibitions
summary: On the way to the Jiuli auction at Xiba City, Ye Fan meets Jin Chixiao, heir of the Huangjin family, who bullies him. Ye Fan secretly holes Jin's treasure ship and pockets about two million jin of the source that leaks out. At the auction he drives up Jin's bids on trivial lots to drain his funds. He wins one cheap lot and cuts it open to reveal top-grade dragon marrow, and pays 1.5 million jin for the Purple Dragon Marrow. In the final bidding war for the Biluo Bell, bidders must show all their source, and Ye Fan wins by a narrow margin with the source he took from Jin's ship. Outside, Jin Chixiao ambushes him with a Huangjin elder at the Immortal Platform realm. Ye Fan, only at Dragon Transformation 3rd level, is exposed as Ye Fan by the Mother Qi Cauldron. He then breaks through to the 'Eight Prohibitions', the ability to fight eight minor realms above his own, and overpowers the elder.

title: Secrets of the Red-Haired
summary: Ye Fan finishes the Huangjin elder with the Eight Prohibitions. He then deals with Jin Chixiao, who set him up twice, and takes the Huangjin family's Earth Milk to purify the Biluo Bell. He leaves Pang Bo to research the ancient star path at the Qishi Academy and reaches Dragon Transformation 4th level. Following records of the Cai clan, who were said to hold one of the Nine Secrets until the Azure Emperor wiped them out with one finger, he finds their ruins. There a Heaven Source seal holds the remnant soul of King Biluo. Biluo tells him that the red-haired monster who imprisoned him was a Heaven Source Master. Ye Fan frees Biluo and returns his bell. In return Biluo says that two Cai disciples stole the Weapon Secret and fled to the Cixing Mountains, then fades away, grieving for the family he left behind to chase immortality. In the Cixing Mountains, echoes of the past show the Cai ancestor, who had outlived his lifespan, coming back with red hair.

title: Seeking a Nine Secret in Qinling
summary: Magnetic stones in the Cixing Mountains replay the past during storms. They show that the two Cai disciples went to Qinling, and that Hua Yunfei and Li Xiaoman have seen the same images. Ye Fan follows the trail of Hua Yunfei's Heaven-Swallowing Demon Art to the Qin Gate, a small, decayed sect deep in Qinling, and joins its eastern branch in disguise. There he wins over two bickering fellow disciples, defeats Gu King insects, and meets a sickly old man of unreadable power. The old man warns him away from the main peak, which holds the Nanling Heavenly Emperor's 'Holy Degree' secret art, and shares high-grade dragon marrow. He also speaks of the Immortal Dragon Nest and the Immortal Transformation Pool, where the Azure Emperor was born. A jade dropped by Princess Yueling points Ye Fan toward a black hole in the back mountain, a sign of Hua Yunfei. Meanwhile Hua Yunfei breaks through to Dragon Transformation 8th level by absorbing ancient corpses. He knows Ye Fan is there and orders Li Xiaoman to kill him at the next Weapon Secret carving.

title: Fighting Hua Yunfei Again
summary: Ye Fan finds the Weapon Secret scattered across stone carvings of ancient weapon marks and realises he must gather them all. At the second carving Hua Yunfei is waiting and offers an alliance, which Ye Fan refuses. Hua Yunfei uses the Immortal Flight Secret and burns his own source with a Phoenix Rebirth art to wound the Holy Body, but Ye Fan counters with the Nirvana Scripture. When Hua Yunfei is spent, Li Xiaoman steps in and ends their old friendship, drawing her sword on Ye Fan with Ruthless techniques. Ye Fan shatters Hua's Great Dao Treasure Vase and, talking about the worth of life, uses a golden yin-yang technique he has just understood. Their joint strongest attack fails. As Ye Fan moves to kill Hua Yunfei, an unseen and oddly familiar power steps in ('This is not your business') and saves the pair. The episode ends with an unseen figure remarking that 'he' is still alive, and a line about the azure lotus descending.

summary: Ye Fan spends half a year working through the Weapon Secret, a supreme art of controlling weapons that could in theory seize even Emperor weapons, and then uses dragon marrow to reach Dragon Transformation 8th level. The sickly old man is seen at the Immortal Ascension Pool looking for 'immortal fate' where the Azure Emperor was born. The Azure Lotus Emperor weapon stirs in the Demon City. Great powers, the Ji clan, the Wang family and a Source Master family gather as the Immortal Dragon Nest is about to appear. Ji Ziyue tracks Ye Fan down and hires him as her Heaven Source Master. When Wang Chong gathers a mob to crush Ye Fan, the demon race defends Pang Bo as heir of the Demon King and Ji Haoyue arrives to protect his sister.

title: Bloodshed at the Immortal Pool
summary: While Wang Teng is away fighting Xiang Yufei, the Central Emperor, Wang Chong enters Qinling with a holy talisman. Ye Fan's source arts get the crowd through the terrain to the Immortal Dragon Nest, where Illusion-grade Divine Marrow is said to extend life by thousands of years. The old Source Master Ouyang Ye flatters him while plotting to take his Heaven Source Scripture. Wang Chong and the elders turn on Ye Fan as soon as the marrow is in sight, and Ji Ziyue and Pang Bo stand with him. Ye Fan fights with the Eight Prohibitions. Then the red-haired monster wakes: the Cai ancestor, who failed to shed his old body in the dragon nest, and who begins slaughtering everyone. Ye Fan holds him back briefly with the Six Immortal Forbidden Seals. Great Xia and Jiuli rush in, the monster seals off the small world, and Ye Fan's Green Copper reacts. An azure lotus rises from the Immortal Ascension Pool and the Azure Emperor steps out of it.

title: An Eternal Azure Lotus
summary: The remnant consciousness of the Azure Emperor ('azure sky through the ages, a single lotus') crushes the red-haired Cai ancestor, who was cursed by the Heaven Source arts late in life. A Holy Spirit, a being born of heaven and earth who calls itself the Immortal Lord of the Central States, then wakes and declares it will wipe out 'lowly' humans. It summons the Taihuang Sword. The Azure Emperor simply takes the Emperor weapon from it, traps it with the Buddhist art 'a grain of sand, one world', and kills it, accepting heaven's backlash as he once did under the immortal peach tree. He tells the demon race that a Great Emperor belongs to all of heaven and earth, leaves the world to the young, and fades. Ye Fan decides that protecting others, not just power, is the real Dao. The scramble for the marrow resumes. Ye Fan uses the Weapon Secret, a terrain-shifting trap and a prepared teleport with Ji Ziyue and Pang Bo to take the Illusion-grade Divine Marrow. He also fights Wang Chong, who carries a Luan Gu Emperor talisman. Then Wang Teng arrives with an emperor sword, the Yin-Yang Sect's master comes with the Yin-Yang Mirror, and Great Xia and Jiuli close in on him.

title: Emperor Weapons Face Off
summary: Ye Fan's friends break through the siege: Li Heishui and another companion, Dongfang Ye, Sheng Huangzi and Ji Ziyue. Using a secret from the ancient Demon King's sea of consciousness that Pang Bo shares, they merge their manifestations into one. Wang Teng clashes with the combined form. Ji Ziyue reveals the Origin Spirit Body, pouring heaven-and-earth energy into Ye Fan at great cost to herself. Jiuli brings out the Jiuli Painting, and Ye Fan's Green Copper moves on its own to shield him. A worn-out elder, most likely the sickly old man, seizes Emperor weapons with the Weapon Secret and tells them to run. title: Death Curse Traps the Holy Body
summary: Wang Yangzhan, master of the Yin-Yang Sect, knows his foundation was wrecked when Ye Fan turned the Jiuli Painting on him and that little of his life is left. He makes a pact with Wang Teng: Ye Fan's life in exchange for Wang Teng's support for the sect. Two months later Ye Fan shares the Illusion-grade Divine Marrow with his friends, who scatter home, and goes with Ji Ziyue to the Qishi Academy. Qi Huoshui ('Qi Xiaoniu') attacks him there, and her brother Qi Lin, the Southern Demon, calls her off. Qi Lin talks with Ye Fan privately. He knows, through the Demon Emperor Palace's Eye of Heaven and Earth, that Ye Fan's group came from another world, and he promises to spare Ye Fan once if they ever meet on the road to becoming emperor. Wang Yangzhan then ambushes Ye Fan and dies casting the Yin-Yang Death Curse, which has no known cure, into him. A Qishi elder gives Ye Fan one day and night to live. Ji Ziyue pours in her Origin Spirit Body power and then reaches for the soul-bound ring from the Bronze Immortal Palace to save him.

title: Immortal Platform Destroys Yin-Yang
summary: Ji Haoyue persuades Ji Ziyue to hold back the ring and trust Ye Fan. Burning from the Death Curse, Ye Fan realises his spine marrow is already dense enough for the Immortal Platform. He sets off a heavenly tribulation so it will destroy the curse from outside while he fights it from inside. The tribulation takes the form of an ancient Heavenly Palace, with copies of the Void Mirror and Hengyu Furnace, and matching versions of himself. Offered three 'perfect' future manifestations, he rejects them and chooses to stay himself. Yin-Yang Sect members try to disrupt the tribulation, but Ji Haoyue holds them off. Ye Fan reaches the 1st Heaven of Immortal Platform, and the Mother Qi Cauldron rises to Holy Lord-grade. He then goes alone to Yin-Yang Divine City and destroys the Yin-Yang Sect with the cauldron. A comic 'recap' after the credits sets up the movie: Wang Teng (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) is sent to marry Ji Ziyue.

title: Farewell to Beidou
summary: After the movie, Ji Haoyue thanks Ye Fan for helping his sister break off her engagement to Wang Teng. Pang Bo and Hei Huang are reunited with him, and Tu Fei is said to be stranded in the Northern Plains. Under the moon Ye Fan tells Ji Ziyue that he and Pang Bo come from Earth, beyond the stars, and that he has spent ten years in Beidou looking for a way home. She promises to help him. When Hei Huang tries to study the small bronze coffin that once struck the Void Mirror, it drags Ye Fan to the Ancient Forbidden Land. There the Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin and a five-coloured altar like the one on Mount Tai wait. Hei Huang can set the coordinates, but Pang Bo decides to stay, having awakened his demon bloodline. Ye Fan says goodbye to Nannan, Li Heishui, Hei Huang and Ji Ziyue, who promises to watch the stars for him, and he leaves through the altar.

title: Leaving Beidou, Wrong Road Home
summary: As Ye Fan sets the altar's coordinates, Li Xiaoman attacks him inside the Ancient Forbidden Land. Her power is borrowed from some peerless forbidden artifact. Her strikes wake the land's wild slaves, among them a former Ji clan expert and the Tianxuan Holy Maiden, and they turn on her. Ye Fan tries to reverse course toward Earth, but the nine-dragon route carries him into the void. There he sees an ancient bronze warship crowded with experts of the ancient races and hides from it. He crash-lands on a toxic dead planet with a broken five-coloured altar. He finds Five Element True Wood and a cauldron with ancient Chinese features, and a holy maiden's skull carved with 'no beginning, no end'. He guesses this refers to Great Emperor Wu Shi, and in the skull he finds a jade pendant holding Taiyin power. A lingering divine will keeps chanting 'return to the homeland, don't be buried in a foreign land' and points to the Ziwei star. Ye Fan repairs the altar and finds a stone coffin, which the lore card links to the Sun Holy Emperor.

title: Ziwei Begins
summary: In a frozen void Ye Fan comprehends the Taiyin True Scripture, one of humanity's two mother scriptures, which holds a complete Immortal Platform section. He blends it with Taiyang power, following the idea of 'Tai Yi'. He survives the tribulation and reaches the 2nd Heaven of Immortal Platform. After seven more years drifting, he agrees to carry the Sun Holy Emperor's lingering will home. The will opens a road to the ancient Ziwei star, and Ye Fan lands at the gate of Bajing Palace, which he wonders might be Laozi's old seat. A boyish Daoist there, the younger brother of palace lord Yin Tiande, tries to seize the Mother Qi Cauldron for his brother's pagoda. He turns out to be an old demon with a Phoenix-blood body and the art 'One Qi Gives Birth to Three Pure Ones'. Ye Fan beats him, turns his king-grade Vajra Bracelet aside with Taiyin power, and kills him. A Taiqing restriction bars him from the palace, so he heads down the mountain.

title: The Young Old Madman
summary: In Tianyuan City on Ziwei, people panic, taking Ye Fan's fall for the arrival of the ancient clans, who once fed on Ziwei's people after the age of the Great Emperors. The flirt Li Tian shows up offering 'protection' to fleeing girls. Two Golden Crow princes decide to shelter at home and guard a treasure under the North Sea. A mysterious Saint has been sitting motionless outside the city, and Ye Fan finds it is the Old Madman. When ancient kings (Black Gold and Divine Phoenix among them) land, Ye Fan defends the Old Madman's body. The Old Madman wakes, uses Taiyin power to return to his youth, kills an ancient king in an instant, and drives off the three ancestral kings. He recalls losing once six thousand years ago and parting from Ye Fan at the Holy Abyss. Ye Fan tells him he is from Earth, and the Old Madman warns that the Thousand-Armed Divine Demon will soon wake.

title: Dongfang Taiyi's Phantom
summary: The Thousand-Armed Divine Demon mocks the Old Madman for giving his life to protect 'ants', and the Old Madman answers that protecting others is humanity's foundation. Ye Fan comes back instead of fleeing, touches the flow of time with the Xing Secret, and powers up the Old Madman with the Jie Secret. Together they attack with Taiyin (the Old Madman) and Taiyang (Ye Fan), the art humans once used to kill ancient monsters. The combined yin and yang wakes the phantom of Dongfang Taiyi, the human demon and ancient Great Saint who fed on ancestral kings, from a Divine Source fragment inside Ye Fan's cauldron. The ancient clans flee at the sight of it. The Old Madman calls Ye Fan humanity's successor, passes him the essence of the Six Paths Reincarnation Fist, and chases the warship beyond the frontier. Months later Ye Fan finds a piece of the warship stained with saint's blood and mourns him. At a grand gathering, Bajing Palace posts a bounty for Ye Fan, and Yin Tiande (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven) vows blood for his brother Yin Tianzhi.

title: Yan Yixi and the Golden Crows
summary: On Ziwei, guests at Sky Wolf Palace's birthday feast for its 'Old Wolf God' talk about Yin Tiande, who is out to avenge his younger brother Yin Tianzhi, and about his circle: the Taiyin Divine Son, Priest San Que and Lu Ya, the Golden Crow clan's Sixth Prince. Ye Fan, whose face is on a wanted portrait, turns up openly and meets the wanderer Yan Yixi, whom the Golden Crows are hunting for spending time with their young princess. When the Golden Crow Ninth Prince (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) arrives, Ye Fan beats him in a duel, then takes on a clone of Lu Ya with the Six-Path Samsara Fist and a newly revealed bow, cutting off the clone's soul and seizing its Golden Banner; Lu Ya swears to settle the karma in person. Yan Yixi asks Ye Fan to help find the Fusang Divine Tree, the Sun Holy Emperor's immortal medicine, whose resting place in the North Sea can only be reached with a map broken into 36 fragments. They plan to ambush fragment carriers at Falling Star River, and Yan names Yi Qingwu of Guanghan Palace, Ziwei's greatest beauty and Yin Tiande's Dao companion, as their target. Yan's junior brother Li Tian joins them: Yan practises the Emotion-Severing Art and Li Tian the Six Heavenly Desires Art, two opposing teachings from the same master.

title: Yi Qingwu's Trap
summary: Ye Fan, Yan Yixi and Li Tian stop Guanghan Palace's sacred palanquin. Yi Qingwu, its Holy Maiden (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven, middle stage), traps them in the Yuanchen Twelve Branches Formation, but Ye Fan takes her Vajra Bracelet and refuses her wager. A clone of the Heavenly Demon Granny (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven, early stage) joins the scramble, recognises Ye Fan as a human Holy Body and wants his blood. Yi Qingwu threatens to unleash the sacred weapon Guanghan Que, so the three withdraw, although Ye Fan quietly took one of the map fragments. Li Tian reveals the Human Desire Dao's sacred weapon, the Goddess Furnace, which Great Emperor Heng Yu forged for their founder, and Ye Fan can control it because it resonates with the Hengyu Scripture he learned in Beidou. Nine days later, at a gorge full of Luo Xia Palace corpses, the Granny's true body ambushes them alongside the Golden Crow Fourth Supreme Elder and the Taiyin Divine Son; Li Tian and Yan Yixi summon the Goddess Furnace, which kills the Granny, and they loot her treasures, including another map fragment.

title: Tanggu and the Goddess Furnace
summary: Among the Heavenly Demon Granny's loot, Ye Fan finds a young branch of the Fusang Divine Tree. It holds Taiyang (solar) power that balances the Taiyin mist he refined earlier. Lu Ya (Golden Crow Sixth Prince, Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven) offers an alliance, since the Golden Crows hold every map fragment except theirs, and at a gathering with the Taiyin Divine Son and Priest San Que the 36 fragments are joined to open the way to Tanggu in the North Sea. Ye Fan compares Tanggu and Fusang with the Classic of Mountains and Seas and wonders how Earth's legends ended up on Ziwei. Once they land, Lu Ya turns on his allies and everyone goes after the Human Desire Dao for using the infamous Goddess Furnace; Ye Fan fights back with the furnace and his Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron. When Yi Qingwu uses a forbidden power, Li Tian pulls her into the furnace, and Ye Fan is sucked in with her. Inside, Yi Qingwu brings out Guanghan Palace itself as a sacred weapon, and its spirit fights Ye Fan with the Seven Forbidden Domain while the furnace's desire power wears at them.

title: Ye Tong, the First Disciple
summary: Four years after the North Sea battle, Ye Fan (now free of the North Sea Eye) reflects on briefly touching the legendary God Forbidden Domain in his fight with Yi Qingwu, a gift from the Sun Holy Emperor's blessing. The Golden Crow Third Prince corners the last descendant of the Sun Holy Emperor, a child guarded by 'Uncle Jiang', to seize the Sun True Scripture. Ye Fan intervenes and the Taiyin Divine Son attacks with a sacred weapon made from an Ancient Moon Queen descendant's skull, but Ye Fan also knows the Taiyin (moon) path, seals the skull with Wang Teng's Immortal Exile and takes it. Uncle Jiang dies of his wounds. Ye Fan comforts the orphan, who insists on becoming his disciple, and he names the boy Ye Tong; the child has a Sun Body, the nine ancient characters from the Sun Holy Emperor help him, and he cultivates even in his sleep. Elsewhere, Zi Tianfeng of Divine Spirit Valley hears that the Old Madman blocked the purple bronze warship but probably fell to the Thousand-Armed Divine Demon, and ancient-clan figures boast of the Heavenly Emperor lineage's coming rise. After a nightmare about Beidou drowning in ancient-race armies, Ye Fan decides to go home; he tells Ye Tong about Earth, and Yan Yixi and Li Tian, disgraced by the Goddess Furnace, want to leave with him through the five-colour altar under Bajing Palace.

title: Slaying Lu Ya
summary: At the Tianji Pavilion, the founder's disciple explains that the dying founder sees cause and effect, and that the fate of Ye Fan's Beidou friends stays undecided until he chooses. Ye Fan compares this to Laplace's demon and Schrödinger's cat. The box's prophecy reads: 'Full-moon night, Ascension Immortal Cliff, Divine Spirit Ancient Scripture, a journey beyond the realm.' As Ye Fan leaves, Lu Ya ambushes him, powered by the forbidden Ten Golden Crows in One Day pill and summoning the Ancestral Golden Crow dharma form; Ye Fan shatters it with his Primordial Spirit Dao Sword and his body. The Golden Crow King's projection appears and scolds Lu Ya, saying he had already cut 60% of the pill's effect so his son could live. Lu Ya still attacks with his last strength, and Ye Fan manifests a Flawless Divine Form, something only Yin Tiande has achieved in this era. The Golden Crow King declares the karma settled and leaves, and Lu Ya dies believing he has done his duty. The Tianji founder tells his disciple that the Golden Crows buried their brightest generation at the Sun Emperor's heir's hands, yet an emperor may still rise from them. Ye Fan learns the scripture was split between the Human King Hall and the Ancient Immortal Monastery, and goes to Ascension Immortal Cliff to watch their exchange.

title: Scripture War at Ascension Cliff
summary: At the full-moon exchange on Ascension Immortal Cliff, an ancient Saint-level killing formation goes off and old masters appear to grab the Divine Spirit Ancient Scripture: the Light King, the Human King, Daoist Qinggu and the Golden Crow King, all at Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven. Yin Tiande, supposedly in seclusion, then shows up, summons Qing Niu, the Divine Ox King who is Laozi's mount (3rd Heaven), with a Qin-era seal script, and uses One Qi Transforms into Three Pure Ones to seize the scripture. Ye Fan intercepts Yin Tiande's fading manifestation, and with Guanghan Palace's sacred weapon, which Yi Qingwu has secretly lent him, plus the Goddess Furnace, he escapes through the ancient formation into Bajing Palace's Taiqing Holy Realm. There he finds the Dao De Jing carved in Earth's script and grasps One Qi Transforms into Three Pure Ones, which opens a black-hole passage heading not to Earth but to Beidou. Accepting that his karma lies in Beidou, he silently addresses his parents after twelve years away. Li Tian and Yan Yixi come with him to rebuild their sect, while Yi Qingwu says goodbye, promising to become a Saint and one day come to Beidou. In Beidou's Demon City, a friend of Ye Fan's who hopes one of them makes it back to their parents fights off killers sent by the Heavenly Emperor's Son.

title: Give Me Back My Miaoyi
summary: Ye Fan forces his way into An Miaoyi's sea of consciousness and relives their past there: she asked him, through an intermediary, to be her Dao Protector before her breakthrough to the Four Poles, and swore she would kill him if she failed. title: North Pole Light and Zi Tianfeng
summary: Deep in the birthplace of the North Pole Immortal Light, an ancient human Saint stops Ye Fan and tells him that no one below Saint may go further. The Saint says Tu Fei, frozen in the ice, isn't in danger: he is cultivating inside a chance tied to an Eternal Scripture and must not be disturbed. Ye Fan begs the Saint to come down from the mountain and protect humanity now that the Old Madman is gone and the ancient Ancestral Kings are waking, but the Saint has already died and merged with the Dao. Leaving Tu Fei to his fortune, Ye Fan reflects on the loneliness of outliving everyone, then meets Yan Yixi at the old Wang lands. Yan reports that Divine Spirit Valley's Zi Tianfeng is holding a gathering in Nanling to draw him out. title: Zi Tianfeng Falls
summary: Ye Fan breaks Zi Tianfeng's Dragon-Skin Drum and his Human King Seal. Zi Tianfeng, who blames Ye Fan for his brother's death, abandons his body and uses Divine Spirit Valley's ancient soul art to take over Ye Fan's, claiming nobody in the Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven can escape it. Ye Fan counters with the Nine Secrets, reminds him of Dongfang Ye, and kills him; the lingering trace of an ancient Ancestral King then appears to avenge its descendant, and Ye Fan erases that too. He tells the Nanling prodigies to stand on their own and asks Yan Yixi to keep tracking the ancient clans. At Ancient Emperor Mountain, burial place of the Undying Heavenly Emperor, the ancient clans greet the awakening of the Heavenly Emperor's Son (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven), who came from the divine egg Ye Fan cut open at Yaochi. Back with the barbarians, Dongfang Man takes Ye Fan to Li Heishui, whose ancient-emperor-descendant wound has been eating his vitality even after the Ji siblings saved him. Ye Fan cleanses the wound with Holy Body blood essence and feeds him the True Dragon Immortal Medicine from the Ten Thousand Dragon Nest, then finally reunites with Ji Ziyue.

title: Back to Purple Mountain
summary: Ye Fan and Ji Ziyue reunite after twelve years, and Ji Haoyue warns that Ye Fan should leave if he sees her only as a neighbour's sister. The friends share news: Yuan Gu has hunted Pang Bo for years for the Demon Emperor's Nine Executions, with the Red Dragon Daoist shielding him until Pang Bo vanished, and the Heavenly Emperor's Son's line has hunted the monkey, Sheng Huangzi. Divine Spirit Valley sends a message across the land that the Holy Body must come and kneel, or the barbarian tribe will be wiped out first. The tribe vows to fight, but Ye Fan answers alone, bluffing that a human Great Emperor is about to return. He sends Li Tian to the valley with a jade pendant recording the 'Mad Emperor' (the Old Madman) killing three Great Saints on an extraterritorial battlefield, and the Divine Spirit Valley Ancestral King (Saint realm) is shaken to see what looks like Quasi-Emperor power. At the Demon race's Immortal Palace in Demon City, the Red Dragon Daoist (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven) says the Qing Jiao King died two years ago and lends Ye Fan a Saint-level Holy Body corpse from the late king's treasury. Leaving his real body with Qing Yi, Ye Fan wears the corpse into Purple Mountain, hoping to find Great Emperor Wu Shi's contingency. There he runs into Duan De and the Blind Old Man of Heaven (Second Great Bandit of the North, 3rd Heaven), and the three pass through a Yin-Yang reversed death gate, a mini star domain and a black hole by sheltering inside the corpse's Bitter Sea, reaching the depths of the mountain.

title: The Wushi Bell
summary: In the depths of Purple Mountain, Ye Fan (in the Holy Body corpse), Duan De and the Blind Old Man find a divine spring of five-coloured jade that speeds up cultivation, probably Great Emperor Wu Shi's bathing pool. Then they find dog hair in it and realise Hei Huang used to bathe there, and Ye Fan wonders whether Hei Huang is looking after Nannan. Past coffins of the Undying Heavenly Emperor's divine generals, they reach Wu Shi's Dao platform, where the Immortal Phoenix Medicine flies off and they harvest King Medicines 70,000–80,000 years old, and Ye Fan recognises the name of Gu Tianshu, a human Saint who chose to guard the tomb. Meanwhile Divine Spirit Valley's elders beg their Ancestral King to hold back for fear of a living human emperor, until the Heavenly Emperor's Son arrives, dismisses the Old Madman's image as a trick and orders the destruction of the barbarian tribe. A Great Emperor killing formation wakes, and Ye Fan calms it with a crescent jade pendant, a relic of a woman Saint from beyond the realm who was tied to Wu Shi, which reveals the Wushi Bell, a Peak Emperor weapon. After fending off the Undying Heavenly Emperor's controlled subordinates, who come to seize the medicines, Ye Fan decides to stay and ring the Wushi Bell for three months so the ancient clans can't tell whether the emperor lives. Duan De lends him the lid of his Supreme Emperor-weapon cauldron and gives him his share of the medicines, and the Blind Old Man gives him Wu Shi's jade so he can get out.
